stage.name: Logroño to Nájera
stage.narrative: You walk through the Rioja vineyards and something has changed. You no longer think about how to walk — your legs know. The rows of grapevines extend to the horizon in orderly lines, and your steps have found a similar order. A week in, the rhythm of the Camino has entered your body: wake, walk, eat, sleep, repeat. In this simplicity, your mind begins to quiet. Not empty, but unburdened.
stage.closing: What would your life look like if it were this simple every day?
